clauses.title: reference recovery before w
clauses.required_hypotheses: K=Q(rho), rho^2=2; B=f^2; g is the printed affine expression in S,T with nonzero constant divisor delta.
clauses.constructed_assertion: The printed field quadrics Q0,Q1,Q3 recover F=(a+cf)g+bfS+ef and E=bSg-eg-af+8. Their f=0 specialization is impossible; their combination yields f*S^2+D_c*f^2=1 before interpreting w.
